name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Add configurable low-priority pre-downloads that finish the current file after a playback grace period and prepare the next TV episode after a watch-progress threshold, with live job status, article maps, cache retention priorities, and disk-space safeguards. Add a bounded, sanitized operator log viewer that correlates Core events with streams and can optionally merge relevant Jellyfin server logs. Add native Jellyfin download support for Streamarr items through the standard permission-aware download endpoint. Harden NZB validation, multi-provider attempt reporting, and stream diagnostics, and improve series artwork compatibility.
